details:
Problem:

Groups on profiles are "random" and don't represent the user due to displaying alphabetically, and actual represented group is tiny and hard to read or even cut off if a long name. The banner for the represented group is also gone

Before beta:

Represented group was the group shown on the user profile, and didn't have a cut off name and displayed the WHOLE group banner.

Why a problem:

Groups being displayed alphabetically don't properly represent the user at first glance if there are more IMPORTANT groups that should be shown (which is kind of the point of a user profile, to help show that user at a glance). For example, the "British sign language" group has its text cut off if represented, and any group with the letter A or a symbol/number is above it, thus it wont even show at the top of the "groups" section. And showing something like that is important.

Its hard to read for those that cannot read well due to it being small, and overall makes represented groups less useful and group banners matter less.

There are many others that use their represented group as an important thing for info on them saying that they are in character, or to not touch them e.t.c. So shortening or not fully displaying them for the user defeats a lot of the purpose on one of the reasons they were added in the first place.

Suggested solutions:

- 1 - Make it so a user can select their top 3 groups that will display on their profile, then a "see all" button to show all the groups. This will display the name AND BANNER of the first group, and Icon/name of the 2nd and 3rd groups.

- 2 - Have it like before where it ONLY shows one group (the one that they are representing), showing BOTH the name and banner in FULL not cut off, then a "show all" button to show all the groups.

How it effects me for example:

The group is a kind of important thing for some users such as myself, especially those that use it to tell important information about them, me for example use it when I'm non verbal and using British sign language to communicate with friends. Having it as my group both represented, and in my profile (for those that have nameplates off and read bios/profiles instead) is important so people don't get confused about it why I'm muted or think I'm using ASL which is a different language than BSL.

Images below:

- Fig 1:

New profile layout, cut off group name and banner not displayed of current represented group (seen from another user)

- Fig 2:

Same user but old layout in live VRChat, you can clearly see the whole group name and the group banner. (Seen from the local user)
title: [build 1878] User profile Groups not properly represented
